'''Siqo Vass''' was a regal [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]], the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the ''[[Krayt's Honor]]''. Despite this, crewperson [[Layn Wynest]] publicly posed as the ship's captain. The reason they did this was unknown, but it was believed to have been to avoid the growing [[humanocentrism]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="WTS" />
